correctness.rationale: Complete eleven-vertex construction, 180 disconnected-four-set facets, 1634 nonempty faces, 812 acyclic matching pairs leaving (1 in degree 0,4 in 5,5 in 6), exhaustive 8081 Hasse incidences, and a zero integral 4-by-5 Morse differential. Explicit Hurewicz reasoning shows all six-cell attaching maps null and proves the integral wedge. Independent mod-two simplicial ranks confirm the Betti numbers. Self-contained standard-library checker is included.

value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the canonical smallest triangle-free four-chromatic graph; its 4-cut complex is a natural chromatic-threshold instance of the ordinary cut construction. The full integral mixed-dimensional homotopy type is substantially more than a routine face count, and nonzero H5 in a pure 6-complex proves non-shellability, providing a concrete case outside the graph families covered by the foundational work.
